content.short: OutDID enables end-to-end private ID verification with Zero Knowledge Proofs.
content.description: OutDID delivers a privacy-first identity verification solution that lets users prove they possess a government-issued document without revealing its details. By employing Zero Knowledge Proofs, it verifies original documents without involving third parties, reducing data liabilities for apps and services while giving users confidence that their private information remains safe. This approach bridges the privacy-versus-verifiability gap, enabling private, trustless identity checks for both Web3 and Web2 platforms.
